derivation: from H3427 (יָשַׁב) and H5011 (נֹב), with a pronominal suffix and a preposition interposed; his dwelling (is) in Nob;

occurrences.text: And Ishbi–benob, which was of the sons of the giant, the weight of whose spear weighed three hundred shekels of brass in weight, he being girded with a new sword, thought to have slain David.
